projects.name: Roosevevlt Island Annual Pool Mural
projects.description: A public art project at the Manhattan Park Pool Club on Roosevelt Island, NYC. The contemporary design of this mural pays tribute to the fluidity of freedom itself, with each stroke and color choice breaking away from traditional forms. This colorful mural on the pool deck spans over 8,000 square feet and took 42 gallons of paint and fifteen days to complete.

projects.name: THE LOOP
projects.description: A project to explore the toxic loop of desire, wanting, and addiction through design so that audiences can see themselves caught in cycles of endless consumption, because this loop quietly shapes our daily behaviors without us realizing.

projects.name: 256 IMAGES
projects.description: 256 Images is a visual research project composed of 256 collected and created images, functioning as a mapping of thought through imagemaking. Conceived as a multi-volume book, the project unfolds across five interconnected sections—Human Animal Nature, Nostalgia, Mental Reframing, Digital, and The Loop—each representing a distinct lens on perception, emotion, and contemporary existence.

projects.name: Just In Case
projects.description: Just In Case explores the multifaceted phenomenon of hoarding—not only the extreme cases often sensationalized on television or the internet but also the everyday behaviors many of us experience. From saving old files to overstocking on groceries, hoarding manifests in various forms, reflecting deeper aspects of our lives.

projects.name: Fire Hydrant
projects.description: This publication delves into the fire hydrants of Manhattan, New York City, exploring 50 unique hydrants that bear distinct marks—stickers, spray paint, and even traces of dog pee. Each hydrant transforms into a piece of public art, serving as a functional object while acting as a canvas for spontaneous, everyday creativity. Through these marks, the hydrants become symbols of community interaction, embodying the idea that everyone can shape art in public spaces.

projects.name: 1920 TYPESPECIMEN
projects.description: “1920” typeface is a take on the Art Deco style capturing its elements with a fresh perspective. This typeface features shapes, balanced designs and clean lines along with graceful curves and sharp edges reminiscent of the 1920s era.
